FLAGELLANT-FLAGELLANT.title: Flagellant
FLAGELLANT-FLAGELLANT.description:
A living corpse whose flesh has festered from prolonged lashing.
When the old crisis was resolved, the longing for pain in his mind guided him to the Spire, continuing his pilgrimage.
FLAGELLANT-FLAGELLANT.cardsModifierDescr: The card of the Flagellant will appear in the store and rewards.
FLAGELLANT-FLAGELLANT.aromaPrinciple: [sine][gray]Heh, the feeling of flesh being torn apart...[/gray][/sine]
FLAGELLANT-FLAGELLANT.eventDeathPreventi: Even the Death can't take me away!
FLAGELLANT-FLAGELLANT.goldMonologue: [sine]I no longer need these worldly possessions...[/sine]
